rulesNotes: The required Direct Assessment course-of-study courses and GENDA 201 are kept at Phoenix in this baseline. This produces 42 CUs of named required Phoenix work; an exceptional entry-course waiver needs separate approval.
General education and elective slots represent the actual catalog credit-category allocations. Each three-CU row is an allocation slot, not an invented required course.
The Sophia partnership publishes education-category eligibility; each proposed placement remains conditional on Phoenix approval for the exact degree and learner.
The 2026–2027 catalog limits undergraduate Direct Assessment students to 48 UOPX CUs per 12-month period. This is not unlimited completion within a subscription.
GENDA 201 must be scheduled in the first term. The program is not eligible for Title IV financial aid.
Requires at least 30 applicable college-level credits OR at least three years of full-time IT-related work experience, plus high-school completion or accepted equivalent.

A previously completed qualifying AA/AS degree can satisfy listed general education/lower-division block requirements; GENDA 201, the 6-CU IS&T elective requirement, and 12-CU upper-division IS&T elective requirement remain subject to the catalog's conditions.

IS&T transfer electives are subject to five-year recency rules measured from the original program Enrollment Agreement sign date; exact upper-level award and departmental applicability require evaluation.

rulesNotes: The required Direct Assessment course-of-study courses and GENDA 201 are kept at Phoenix in this baseline. This produces 39 CUs of named required Phoenix work; an exceptional entry-course waiver needs separate approval.
General education and elective slots represent the actual catalog credit-category allocations. Each three-CU row is an allocation slot, not an invented required course.
The Sophia partnership publishes education-category eligibility; each proposed placement remains conditional on Phoenix approval for the exact degree and learner.
The 2026–2027 catalog limits undergraduate Direct Assessment students to 48 UOPX CUs per 12-month period. This is not unlimited completion within a subscription.
GENDA 201 must be scheduled in the first term. The program is not eligible for Title IV financial aid.
Requires at least 30 applicable college-level credits AND at least three years of full-time healthcare-related leadership experience, plus high-school completion or accepted equivalent.
